content_sections.heading: About CSIR-CFTRI
content_sections.text: CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute is in Mysuru, Karnataka. The notice describes it as a constituent National Laboratory of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR). This post is for the project "Development of Highly Efficient Oxygen Scavenger Sachets Using Natural Rubber Silica Composites for Enhanced Food Preservation" (project number GAP00667).

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CFTRI Project Associate-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 35 years. Age, educational qualification and experience are all counted as on the date of the walk-in interview, which is 5 November 2026. First class in M. Sc. in Food Science and Technology / Food Science and Nutrition or equivalent from a recognized university AND 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science & Technology Organisations Experience in food analysis techniques and product development. These relaxations apply "or as per Govt. of India instructions issued in this regard from time to time". SC, ST, PwBD and OBC candidates must bring their original category certificate in the proper format, issued by the appropriate authority. Under CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024, a person's total time as project staff across CSIR labs and institutes cannot be more than 6 years. If you have already served 6 years as project staff in any CSIR lab or institute, you are not eligible for this post. For the full details of the eligibility for this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview at CSIR-CFTRI, Opp. Railway Museum, Mysuru-570020. If a large number of candidates apply, a committee will shortlist them using one or more of these methods: The Director, CSIR-CFTRI, makes the final decision on who may appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and on contract, at CSIR-CFTRI, Mysuru, Karnataka. The notice gives two terms for the engagement. Page 1 says it runs at first up to 30 November 2026, and can be extended up to November 2027 if funds are available and the work needs it, or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. Instruction 12 says it runs at first for one year from the date of joining, depending on funds. It may then be extended or cut short based on conduct, performance and the institute's needs, and extended further on the Review Committee's recommendation. The engagement cannot go beyond the project's term and ends automatically when the project ends. Being engaged as project staff gives no right to register for higher degrees, and no right to a permanent job at CSIR-CFTRI, CSIR or its labs and institutes. A selected candidate cannot leave without the Director's prior approval. To leave before the tenure is complete, you must give one month's notice with a specific reason, or pay one month's stipend instead of the notice. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. Any canvassing, or bringing political or other influence, disqualifies the candidate. On any matter the notice does not cover, the Director's decision is final.

Then sign the declaration. If your higher degree is ongoing under AcSIR, or under a university that has an MoU with CSIR or its labs, get the No Objection Certificate in Annexure-II signed and stamped by your supervisor or guide and by the Registrar or administrative authority. Report to CSIR-CFTRI, Opp. Railway Museum, Mysuru-570020 on 5 November 2026 between 09.30 AM and 10.30 AM, and hand in the form at the walk-in interview. faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate-II posts does CSIR-CFTRI have?
faq.answer: There is 01 post, under project GAP00667 on oxygen scavenger sachets made with natural rubber silica composites.

faq.question: Q2. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 5 November 2026 (Thursday) at CSIR-CFTRI, Opp. Railway Museum, Mysuru-570020. Reporting is from 09.30 AM to 10.30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: It is Rs. 35,000 plus HRA if you have qualified CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or a similar national test, and Rs. 28,000 plus HRA otherwise.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification do I need?
faq.answer: You need a first class in M. Sc. in Food Science and Technology / Food Science and Nutrition or equivalent from a recognized university, and 2 years' R&D experience in industrial or academic institutions or S&T organisations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit, and is there relaxation?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years on the interview date. SC, ST, PwBD and women candidates get 05 years of relaxation, and OBC candidates get 03 years.

faq.question: Q6. I am doing a PhD under AcSIR. Can I attend?
faq.answer: Yes. Bring the No Objection Certificate in the Annexure-II format, signed and stamped by your supervisor or guide and by the Registrar or administrative authority.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the engagement last?
faq.answer: Page 1 of the notice says it runs at first up to 30 November 2026 and can be extended up to November 2027, depending on funds, or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. It never goes beyond the project's term.

faq.question: Q8. Will I be paid travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply even if qualified?
faq.answer: Anyone who has already completed a total of 6 years as project staff in any CSIR lab or institute, under CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024.
